newCodes.E-REC-5: Retrieved by a search-syntax artefact; the record lies outside the biomedical and exercise-science domain and engages no eligibility criterion. The generating artefact in this pass is PubMed proximity distance 0, which matches two adjacent words in either order, so "machine fly"[tiab:~0] retrieves "on-the-fly machine learning" papers.
newCodes.E-REC-6: The record is not a research report: a patent, publisher media asset, equipment listing, dataset deposit, commercial promotion or similar non-study document.
newCodes.E-REC-7: Reserved and not issued in this pass. Trial-registry record without posted results, in the case where the registered intervention would otherwise be eligible. No retrieved registration met that condition.
newCodes.E-EXP-7: An exercise contrast exists and is the manipulated variable, but the comparator is a distinct condition rather than the index condition, a pre-specified related condition, or an admissible secondary comparator, so the contrast does not bear on X versus Y.
newCodes.E-DES-6: Single anatomical-variant case report of the index muscle: describes an atypical configuration in one or a few specimens and cannot support a claim about typical structure.

amendments.effectOnCertainty: None. Post-hoc amendments cannot raise certainty (eligibility plan section 6.2).

amendments.reason: A PubMed record keyed by PMID and an index record with no identifier are the same paper, and the identifier-only rule could never merge them. The first run left 11 such pairs unmerged; the amended rule merged them and every fuzzy-only merge was inspected individually.
amendments.effectOnCertainty: None. Deduplication affects counts, not evidence.

screeningDiscipline.doubleScreening: Eligibility plan section 7.1 requires re-screening at least 20 per cent of stage-1 records and 100 per cent of stage-3 records on a separate pass. This pass was executed inside a single session on a single day, so the second pass was not blind and was not separated by a day. That is a deviation and is recorded as limitation L-8 rather than presented as satisfied.
screeningDiscipline.directionBlindness: Stage-1 decisions were taken from population, exposure, comparator and outcome type. Where a structured abstract stated the result, the direction was visible; assumption EA2 already treats single-screener work as weaker than two independent screeners.
screeningDiscipline.symmetryTest: Every exclusion code used more than a handful of times was reviewed against the records it was applied to. E-POP-5, E-POP-1, E-POP-4, E-EXP-3 and E-OUT-2 carry the bulk of the exclusions and are applied to records that do not report a press-versus-fly contrast at all, so no direction asymmetry is detectable in them. No exclusion code in this pass was applied to a record because of the direction of its result.
